name: Seeed Studio Multi-Channel Relay Switch
description: The `seeed_multi_channel_relay` component controls the relays of the Seeed Studio Grove multi-channel relay boards over [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/): the [Grove 4-Channel SPDT Relay](https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/Grove-4-Channel_SPDT_Relay/) and the [Grove 8-Channel Solid State Relay](https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/Grove-8-Channel_Solid_State_Relay/).

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the board. Defaults to `0x11`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) bus to use. Required with more than one bus.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.
